The following events took place in '''340 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Praxeum ship/Legends|training vessel]] ''[[Chu'unthor]]'' crashed on the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="NEC" />
*[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] left an extensive collection of Jedi [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]] from the wreckage of the ''Chu'unthor'' on the planet Dathomir.<ref name="NEC" />
*A yellow-eyed [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] foiled an assassination attempt on an ambassador. {{Circa}}<ref name="CoPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
